data.narrative:
Stardust Solutions is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Yanai Yedvab that has raised $75M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private frontier-tech peers in Climate & Energy (Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix among them) alongside 1 public comparable (LNZA).

Only one valuation method was applicable to this analysis. Stage-progression modeling, which uses the company's $75M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, yields an implied valuation of $150M. A peer-median approach could not be applied: while 8 same-sector peers exist, none met the narrow filtering criteria (same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier), and a broad all-sector median would lack relevance to frontier-climate positioning.

The triangulated range supported by this single-method analysis is $128M (low) to $172M (high), with a median of $150M. This range reflects a conservative 15% discount and 15% premium around the point estimate. The primary uncertainty stems from the single-method foundation: absent sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables, the analysis lacks cross-validation. Refinement would require either narrower peer data at Series A or later-stage comps with disclosed round mechanics.
